title: Pigeons, Cookies, and a Supermarket Friend
excerpt: A day of wandering KLCC brought an unexpected friendship with a girl from Sabah, pigeons fed chocolate cookies by a lake, and a hard lesson in impulse souvenir shopping.

photos.alt: Roti canai telur on a stainless steel divided plate with three dipping sauces — curry, dhal, and sambal — at a KL kopitiam
Japanese-style salad bowl topped with shoyu salmon, mango cubes, pineapple, shredded carrot, seaweed, fish roe, and sunflower seeds
Silver sculptural fountains shaped like leaping fish in the reflecting lake at KLCC Park, surrounded by tall palms and city buildings
